gloss: to reflect on; to reconsider; to feel remorse

definitions.gloss: to reflect on one's actions; to feel remorse; to reconsider
definitions.explanation: To look back on one's own behavior or mistakes and recognize what went wrong, often with a sense of regret and a commitment to do better.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反省|はんせい}した。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧{反省|はんせい}して⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧だった。
examples.english: He didn't seem to feel remorseful at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{反省|はんせい}して、⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}さない→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ようにしたい。
examples.english: I want to reflect on my failure and make sure I don't repeat the same mistake next time.

notes:
A culturally significant concept in Japan. ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧ goes beyond simple reflection — it implies acknowledging mistakes, feeling genuine regret, and resolving to improve. It is frequently expected in social and professional contexts when someone has done something wrong.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{反省|はんせい}する: to deeply reflect/feel remorse
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to show no sign of remorse
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}{点|てん}→反省点：28214_hanseiten⟧: points for reflection/improvement
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}{会|かい}→反省会：28191_hanseikai⟧: review meeting, post-mortem
- ⟦{反省|はんせい}{文|ぶん}→反省文：20631_hanseibun⟧: written apology/reflection

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese schools and workplaces, ⟦{反省|はんせい}→反省：03570_hansei⟧ is a routine practice. Students may be asked to write ⟦{反省|はんせい}{文|ぶん}→反省文：20631_hanseibun⟧ (reflection essays) after misbehavior, and teams hold ⟦{反省|はんせい}{会|かい}→反省会：28191_hanseikai⟧ (review sessions) after events or projects.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to regret — focuses on the feeling of wishing one hadn't done something, without the constructive element
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back — neutral reflection without the implication of having done something wrong
